info.title: Paer Beneficiary API
info.description:
> ## 👋 Three APIs, one site
>
> This documentation site bundles **three Paer APIs** under a single nav.
> Right now you're looking at the **Beneficiary API**. To see the others
> (**Quotes API**, **User API**), look for the **dropdown at the top of
> the left sidebar** — just above the search box. It currently reads
> **"Beneficiary API ▾"**. Click it to switch.

The **Beneficiary API** owns counterparty records — the companies your
customers send money to — plus the AML screening layered on top of them.

> **New here?** Start with the **Quotes API** (in the sidebar dropdown)
> for the money-movement surface, and the **User API** for auth + KYB.
> This service plugs into both: every quote that names a beneficiary
> references a record stored here.

## What you can do

- **Add a counterparty** — name, address, KYB-style attestation
  (entity type, industry, source of funds, signatories, UBOs).
- **Attach payout rails** — IBAN (EUR/SEPA), PIX (Brazil), SPEI
  (Mexico), sort-code (UK), IFSC (India), UPI, ACH, SWIFT correspondent.
  Validation happens at write time: IBAN mod-97, CNPJ/CPF mod-11,
  CLABE 18-digit checksum, BIC ISO 9362, etc.
- **Screen automatically on creation** — three independent checks:
  - **Sanctions** (UN / EU CFSP / OFAC SDN / HMT)
  - **PEP** (politically-exposed persons)
  - **Adverse media** (negative news)
  Plus **CoP / VoP** name-matching at the payout-account level
  (Confirmation/Verification of Payee under SEPA Instant Oct-2025 mandate).
- **Operator dispositions on flagged hits** — Paer-Internal A/B users
  can override `flagged → active | blocked` with B-quorum (a B-user's
  override goes to `pending_approval` until a second A/B co-signs).

## Lifecycle

```
draft  ──(complete required fields)──▶  pending_screening
                                                │
                              (sanctions+pep+adverse_media run)
                                                │
                          ┌─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┐
                          ▼                     ▼                     ▼
                        active              flagged                blocked
                                            (operator                (operator
                                             review)                  decision)
```

## v1 scope: company-to-company only

`type: "individual"` is reserved in the schema but rejected at the API
with `company_to_individual_not_supported_in_v1`. C2P flows arrive in v2
without a schema migration — only the validation flag flips.

## Auth

Same as the other two services: `X-API-Key: paer_sk_...`. Keys come from
the **User API** (use the sidebar dropdown). Customer users see only
their own company's beneficiaries (cross-company access returns 404, not
403, so existence isn't leaked). Paer-Internal users see everything via
the `/v1/admin/*` surface and the operator HTML dashboard at `/admin`.

## Adding your first beneficiary

```bash
curl -X POST https://beneficiary-api.paer.dk/v1/beneficiaries \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-API-Key: paer_sk_..." \
  -d '{
    "type": "business",
    "name": "Acme GmbH",
    "country_of_formation": "DE",
    "country_of_residence":  "DE",
    "address_line1": "Musterstraße 1",
    "city": "Berlin",
    "postal_code": "10115",
    "country": "DE",
    "initial_payout_account": {
      "label": "Primary",
      "currency": "EUR",
      "country": "DE",
      "account_holder_name": "Acme GmbH",
      "details": {
        "rail": "IBAN",
        "iban": "DE89370400440532013000",
        "bic":  "COBADEFFXXX"
      }
    }
  }'
```

You get back the full record including the screening event timeline and
the resulting `status` (typically `active` for clean counterparties,
`flagged` if any of the three checks hit).

AchDetails.title: AchDetails
AchDetails.description: US — ACH routing (9 digits) + account number.

BeneficiaryFull.title: BeneficiaryFull
BeneficiaryFull.description: Drill-down shape — full record + payout accounts.

BeneficiarySlim.title: BeneficiarySlim
BeneficiarySlim.description:
List-view shape — no PII beyond name + country. Mirrors paer-user-api's
slim-list pattern for admin endpoints.

BeneficiaryUpdate.title: BeneficiaryUpdate
BeneficiaryUpdate.description:
PATCH body — every field optional. Status and screening cache columns
are NOT here; those are mutated by status-transition / screening flows.

DispositionApprove.title: DispositionApprove
DispositionApprove.description:
Body for `POST /v1/admin/screening-events/{id}/dispose/approve` —
second signature on a B-proposed disposition.

DispositionPropose.title: DispositionPropose
DispositionPropose.description:
Body for `POST /v1/admin/screening-events/{id}/dispose` — operator
override on a flagged result. A solo applies, B routes to pending_approval.

examples.basis: Match is a politically-exposed person on the EU CFSP list with name similarity 78%; full DOB + country of residence diverge. Confirmed via secondary source. Risk acceptable per AML policy 4.2.

DispositionWithdraw.title: DispositionWithdraw
DispositionWithdraw.description:
Body for `POST /v1/admin/screening-events/{id}/dispose/withdraw` —
proposer cancels their own pending disposition before approval.

PixDetails.title: PixDetails
PixDetails.description:
Brazil — PIX instant rail. Key + key type.

`pix_key_type` is declared before `pix_key` so the latter's field-validator
can read it from `info.data` (Pydantic v2 fills `info.data` left-to-right).

SepaInstantDetails.title: SepaInstantDetails
SepaInstantDetails.description:
SEPA Instant routing — same shape as IBAN, different rail discriminator
so the caller signals 'route via SEPA Instant, not vanilla SEPA'.

SortCodeDetails.title: SortCodeDetails
SortCodeDetails.description: UK — sort code (6 digits) + account number (8 digits).

SpeiDetails.title: SpeiDetails
SpeiDetails.description: Mexico — SPEI rail. CLABE is mandatory and exactly 18 digits.

SwiftDetails.title: SwiftDetails
SwiftDetails.description: International correspondent banking — SWIFT BIC + account.

WireDetails.title: WireDetails
WireDetails.description: US Fedwire / general bank wire — same shape as SWIFT but tagged WIRE.

ApiKey.description: Customer API key (`paer_sk_...`). Minted by paer-user-api; this service introspects via /v1/keys/introspect for resolution.
